subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should existing plugins keep `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` for the announced deprecation window, or should this PR intentionally make all unresolved approvals fail closed immediately?
rationale: Preserving the field retains a shipped permissive execution fallback, while ignoring it immediately breaks existing plugin behavior; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for this security-versus-upgrade choice.

options.title: Preserve through deprecation
options.body: Continue honoring `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` for the stated release window, warn plugin authors, and remove it only in the announced breaking release.

options.title: Approve immediate fail-closed cutover
options.body: Ignore the field now, but explicitly approve the compatibility break and provide release and upgrade guidance for affected plugins.

recommendation.title: Preserve through deprecation
recommendation.body: Continue honoring `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` for the stated release window, warn plugin authors, and remove it only in the announced breaking release.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the fail-closed approval segment and has the strongest history ownership of this exact execution-authority boundary.
